## Fixes

- Chat: the caret now lines up with the text you type. The visible text and the input used different padding and font size.
- IDE: far fewer false red underlines. The editor no longer flags missing modules or JSX in TypeScript files it checks alone; real syntax errors stay underlined, and type errors still come from `tsc` in the Problems panel. JSON files accept comments and trailing commas.

## IDE

- Autosave: edited files save 1 second after you stop typing, and when you close their tab.
- Saving no longer overwrites what you type while the file is being written.
